Straight peak edges
Peak tip projecting upward less aggressively due to the lowered starting position

Style Effect

A Low Gorge 110° Peak Lapel creates:

Maximum lapel length illusion
Strong V-shaped torso emphasis
Broader-looking shoulders
Classic 1930s/1940s drape-cut tailoring aesthetic
Excellent proportions for double-breasted jackets and long-line single-breasted coats

Compared with a standard 110° peak, the lowered gorge makes the lapel appear approximately 10–15% longer visually while preserving the exact same 110° peak geometry.
